user.title: Priority Command Arbitration
user.description: Give every command a level of authority, so a manual action and an automation can disagree without one silently clobbering the other. Applies to every supported entity, but changes nothing until a service call actually asks for a priority: by default all commands share the lowest level and simply replace each other, exactly as they do today.

priority_names.name: Level names
priority_names.description: Rename any level. Leave a field blank to restore the shipped name. Lower numbers still win, whatever they are called.

data_description.merge_enabled: Lets an override fill in what it leaves unset from the levels below it: a light held on keeps the color and brightness adaptive lighting sets underneath, and a thermostat held at a setpoint keeps the mode its schedule sets. When on, the cards show a Merge toggle beside the level and the action editors offer merge_down. When off, nothing merges, neither appears, and a merge_down already in an action is ignored.
data_description.merge_down: Whether an override merges when it does not say so itself. Only applies while merging is enabled. The Merge toggle on the cards starts here.

abort.already_configured: Priority arbitration is already set up.

error.duplicate_names: Two levels have the same name. Give each level its own.

relinquish.name: Relinquish
relinquish.description: Clear one priority slot and hand control to the next-highest command still in force.

relinquish_all.name: Relinquish all
relinquish_all.description: Clear every slot above Default, returning the entity to ordinary control.

set.name: Set slot
set.description: Write a command into a priority slot directly, without going through the domain service.

service.name: Service
service.description: Service name within the entity's own domain, such as turn_on.

data.name: Data
data.description: Payload for the command, such as brightness or temperature.

priority_ttl.name: Hold for
priority_ttl.description: How long the slot holds before clearing itself, as seconds or a duration. Omit or use 0 to hold until relinquished. Not valid at priority 8.

merge_down.name: Merge down
merge_down.description: Fill in what this command leaves unset (a light's color or brightness, a thermostat's mode) from the same service at the levels below it. Omit to use the integration option.

get.name: Get array
get.description: Return the full priority array for each target entity.
